outcome: Longer stay in neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
cohort: The review focuses on pregnant women diagnosed with preeclampsia and their fetuses, particularly those at risk of intrauterine growth restriction and other complications.
finding: Preeclampsia significantly affects fetal behavior, and the Kurjak Antenatal Neurodevelopmental Test (KANET) using 4D ultrasound is highlighted as a safe and relevant tool for assessing fetal neurodevelopment and predicting adverse outcomes in fetuses at risk due to severe preeclampsia.
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean section (CS) is listed as a potential perinatal complication in fetuses from preeclamptic pregnancies.
